headline: A New Utility Detects Hidden Recording Glasses Nearby
lede: ZuckOff scans local Bluetooth signatures to identify wearable recording hardware in your vicinity. This offline utility provides a technical layer of awareness against unauthorized surveillance in public or private settings.

headline: Countering Smart Eyewear with Local Proximity Alerts
lede: As camera-equipped wearables proliferate, new privacy tools are emerging to alert users to nearby device signatures. This mobile app offers a direct response to concerns over surreptitious filming in our daily lives.

headline: Jared Palmer Releases Lightweight Qwen-Based Decision Agents
lede: The Kev model family brings efficient, Jev-inspired decision-making to the Qwen3.5 architecture. By prioritizing a smaller footprint, these agents simplify the deployment of reasoning tasks for developers.

headline: The Absurd Efficiency of AI-Powered String Padding
lede: The jev-leftpad package serves as a tongue-in-cheek critique of modern dependency sprawl and excessive AI integration. It forces complex network calls for trivial tasks that require only a single line of code.
pullquote: The over-engineering of basic utilities reveals how quickly we trade deterministic simplicity for the fragility of complex infrastructure.

headline: Behind the Scenes of the 1996 Grim Fandango Design
lede: A newly surfacing puzzle document from LucasArts reveals the complex narrative architecture behind a landmark adventure game. These primary source materials offer a rare glimpse into the creative constraints of a bygone era.

headline: Google Releases Open Source Agentic Orchestrator AX
lede: AX provides a dedicated control plane for managing billions of concurrent, stateful agent sessions. Built to handle bursty workloads, the platform optimizes workspace sandboxing and sub-second task resumption.

headline: Samsung Expands Manufacturing Capacity for High-Density HBM4
lede: To meet rising demand for AI-specific memory, Samsung is ramping up its production lines for next-generation DRAM stacks. This move requires significant engineering upgrades to handle delicate, multi-layer silicon die thinning.

headline: Mini-AGI Enables Continual Learning on Consumer Hardware
lede: This byte-level language model runs on just 8GB of VRAM by paging experts between disk and memory. It demonstrates that self-evolving AI, resistant to catastrophic forgetting, is viable on standard desktop hardware.

headline: Disney+ Updates Agreement to Introduce Ads Across All Tiers
lede: A revision to the platform’s subscriber agreement now permits promotional content and product integrations within previously ad-free subscriptions. This change signals a broader shift toward cable-style revenue models in the streaming industry.

headline: Qwen-Image-2.1 Unifies Generation and Editing in One Model
lede: The updated Qwen image model introduces professional-grade editing and native transparency support in a compact 7B-parameter architecture. It provides an efficient toolset for developers needing integrated text-to-image capabilities.
